name: Cape Floral Region Protected Areas
description: At the southwestern tip of South Africa, this cluster of national parks, nature reserves and mountain areas protects the Cape's fynbos, a tough, fine-leaved shrubland shaped by Mediterranean weather and regular wildfires. It sits in the smallest of the world's six floral kingdoms, yet holds over 9,000 plant species, about 69 percent found nowhere else. Visitors see a remarkable variety of wildflowers.
